$description: EASM One design tokens: the single source. Edit this file, then run `pnpm tokens`. Every other token file is generated from it.

primary.$description: Enterprise Blue for text and lines: links, selected text, checked controls. Text-safe on white and tints; on the grey float panel use primary-hover (primary is under 4.5:1 there).

primary-hover.$description: Hover fill for primary controls, and blue text on the grey float panel.

primary-pressed.$description: Pressed fill for primary-coloured controls. Components use primary-fill-pressed; kept for applications.

primary-surface.$description: Light blue tint for selected rows, chips and tags. Text on it is primary or text.

range-fill.$description: Days between the two ends of a selected date range: primary-fill at 12%.

primary-border.$description: Soft blue for icon fills and selected tints.

primary-fill.$description: Bright Enterprise Blue for filled actions: primary buttons, the active navigation item, the selected date. White text on it.

on-primary-fill.$description: Text and icons on primary-fill in every state (primary buttons, the active navigation item, the selected date).

on-primary-fill-muted.$description: Translucent white for counts and small chips on primary-fill.

halo.$description: Soft focus glow around the solid focus edge: primary-fill at 20%, so it follows primary-fill.

text.$description: Headings and body text: near-black cool ink.

text-secondary.$description: Helper text, captions and metadata: warm grey.

text-disabled.$description: Disabled labels only; not for content people must read.

surface-hover.$description: Hover state of surface controls; disabled fill.

row-hover.$description: Hovered row in a table on a white card.

track.$description: Grey track: tab and segmented-control rails, chips, filled secondary buttons, sidebar cards.

track-hover.$description: Hover on a track or grey fill.

track-pressed.$description: Pressed on a track; switch track when off.

tint-hover.$description: Hover wash on a white or grey panel: text at 7%. Rows and options in pickers and lists.

tint-subtle.$description: Faint wash for inactive or outside-range cells: text at 4%.

float.$description: Grey panel for menus, dropdowns and popovers that open over white cards.

float-hover.$description: Highlighted option inside a grey panel.

ink-panel.$description: Dark ink panel for toasts and menus opened from a primary action.

ink-panel-hover.$description: Highlighted option inside a dark ink panel.

on-ink-muted.$description: Icons and secondary text on ink-panel.

on-ink-strong.$description: Strongest text and icons on ink-panel: a hovered control.

border.$description: Grey outline for fields, dropdowns, checkboxes and chart axes. Meets 3:1 on white and the page.

border-subtle.$description: Inner dividers and table lines. Decorative only.

success.$description: Success text and icons on success-surface or surface. Pair with a word or icon.

danger.$description: Errors and destructive buttons (white text on it). On the grey float panel, red text uses danger-hover.

danger-hover.$description: Hover fill for destructive buttons, and red text on the grey float panel.

on-danger.$description: Text and icons on danger and danger-hover fills (destructive buttons).

danger-highlight.$description: Highlighted destructive row in a grey panel. Text on it is danger-hover.

danger-halo.$description: Soft glow around a focused field in error: danger at 14%.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons on warning-surface or surface.

icon-success.$description: Status icon on a success badge (3:1 on badge-success).

icon-warning.$description: Status icon on a warning badge (3:1 on badge-warning).

icon-danger.$description: Status icon on a danger badge (3:1 on badge-danger).

presence-online.$description: Presence: online. A filled dot; pair with the status in the accessible name.

presence-offline.$description: Presence: offline. A hollow ring (3:1 on white and on the faint grey fill).

presence-idle.$description: Presence: idle (tab open, no input). A ring in the online colour: there but not at the keys.

presence-call.$description: Presence: on a call. A filled dot with a white phone sign, beside any presence.

scrim.$description: Warm backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

chart-blue.$description: Blue data colour: bars, lines, segments and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-blue-tint.$description: Blue tint: legend chips, metric tiles and icon squares.

chart-blue-ink.$description: Blue text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-violet.$description: Violet data colour: bars, lines, segments and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-violet-tint.$description: Violet tint: legend chips, metric tiles and icon squares.

chart-violet-ink.$description: Violet text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-teal.$description: Teal data colour: bars, lines, segments and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-teal-tint.$description: Teal tint: legend chips, metric tiles and icon squares.

chart-teal-ink.$description: Teal text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-green.$description: Green data colour: bars, lines, segments and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-green-tint.$description: Green tint: legend chips, metric tiles and icon squares.

chart-green-ink.$description: Green text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-amber.$description: Amber data colour: bars, lines, segments and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-amber-tint.$description: Amber tint: legend chips, metric tiles and icon squares.

chart-amber-ink.$description: Amber text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-coral.$description: Coral data colour: bars, lines, segments and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-coral-tint.$description: Coral tint: legend chips, metric tiles and icon squares.

chart-coral-ink.$description: Coral text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-sky.$description: Sky data colour: bars, lines, segments and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-sky-tint.$description: Sky tint: legend chips, metric tiles and icon squares.

chart-sky-ink.$description: Sky text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-honey.$description: Slate grey data colour (the tone keeps its old id, honey): bars, lines, segments and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-honey-tint.$description: Slate grey tint: legend chips, metric tiles and icon squares.

chart-honey-ink.$description: Slate grey text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-indigo.$description: Indigo accent (between blue and violet): small marks, icons and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-indigo-tint.$description: Indigo tint: avatars, tags and icon squares.

chart-indigo-ink.$description: Indigo text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-rose.$description: Rose accent (coral turned towards violet): small marks, icons and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-rose-tint.$description: Rose tint: avatars, tags and icon squares.

chart-rose-ink.$description: Rose text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-orange.$description: Orange accent (the signature orange, deepened for marks): small marks, icons and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-orange-tint.$description: Orange tint: avatars, tags and icon squares.

chart-orange-ink.$description: Orange text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-lime.$description: Lime accent (green turned towards yellow): small marks, icons and dots (3:1 on card and page).

chart-lime-tint.$description: Lime tint: avatars, tags and icon squares.

chart-lime-ink.$description: Lime text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

chart-plum.$description: Plum accent (violet turned towards rose): small marks, icons and dots (3:1 on card and page). The Marketing dashboard's accent.

chart-plum-tint.$description: Plum tint: avatars, tags and icon squares.

chart-plum-ink.$description: Plum text on its tint or on white (4.5:1).

orange.$description: The second brand colour (#FF6A00 in the logo), for attention: what is new or waiting. Never a control colour; controls stay blue. Too light for text on white: use orange-ink.

orange-surface.$description: Orange tint behind an attention count or highlight.

orange-border.$description: Orange edge for a highlighted item.

orange-fill.$description: Solid orange behind white text (the notification count): the step where white passes 4.5:1.

signature.$description: Brand orange. Marketing surfaces and the Junction mark only; use dark text on it, never white. Working controls stay blue.

dark.$description: Marketing home background only; no component reads it. Text on it is white; accents are signature.

paper.$description: Ground of the paper-world brand films and their storyboards. Text on it is text or orange-ink.

orange-ink.$description: Orange as text on white or on orange-surface (4.5:1): a count, a highlight, what is new.

ai.$description: AI role: marks what the assistant made or did (AI messages, insights, assistant calls, collected responses). A role, not a chart colour; 3:1 on card and page.

ai-surface.$description: AI role fill: chips, tiles and the background of AI-authored content.

ai-ink.$description: AI role text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

stage-1.$description: Lead stage 1, Inquiry: the lightest step of one blue ramp. Text is the body text.

stage-4.$description: Lead stage 4, Admitted. Text on it is white.

stage-5.$description: Lead stage 5, Enrolled: the deepest step. Text on it is white.

stage-closed.$description: Lead stage, closed (lost, withdrawn): muted, off the ramp. Text is secondary.

stage-stopped.$description: Lead stage, do not contact: the danger fill, text in danger-hover.

product-support.$description: Support dashboard accent (demand list CLR-01): the switcher tile, home hero, breadcrumb and origin chips. Never a status colour.

product-support-ink.$description: Support accent text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

product-knowledge.$description: Knowledge dashboard accent (demand list CLR-01): the switcher tile, home hero, breadcrumb and origin chips. Never a status colour.

product-knowledge-ink.$description: Knowledge accent text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

product-marketing.$description: Marketing dashboard accent (demand list CLR-01): the switcher tile, home hero, breadcrumb and origin chips. Never a status colour.

product-marketing-ink.$description: Marketing accent text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

product-automation.$description: Automation dashboard accent (demand list CLR-01): the switcher tile, home hero, breadcrumb and origin chips. Never a status colour.

product-automation-ink.$description: Automation accent text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

product-forms.$description: Forms dashboard accent (demand list CLR-01): the switcher tile, home hero, breadcrumb and origin chips. Never a status colour.

product-forms-ink.$description: Forms accent text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

temperature-hot.$description: Hot: likely to apply soon. Never coral (danger) or the signature orange. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

temperature-hot-ink.$description: Temperature hot: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

temperature-warm.$description: Warm: interested, not yet moving. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

temperature-warm-ink.$description: Temperature warm: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

temperature-cold.$description: Cold: no recent interest. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

temperature-cold-ink.$description: Temperature cold: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

sentiment-positive.$description: Positive: how a conversation felt. Not green: a feeling is not a success. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

sentiment-positive-ink.$description: Sentiment positive: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

sentiment-neutral.$description: Neutral. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

sentiment-neutral-ink.$description: Sentiment neutral: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

sentiment-negative.$description: Negative: a caller’s mood, not an error, so never red. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

sentiment-negative-ink.$description: Sentiment negative: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

sentiment-mixed.$description: Mixed. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

sentiment-mixed-ink.$description: Sentiment mixed: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

sensitivity-public.$description: Public answer: fine to show. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

sensitivity-public-ink.$description: Sensitivity public: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

sensitivity-personal.$description: Personal answer: about a person. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

sensitivity-personal-ink.$description: Sensitivity personal: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

sensitivity-restricted.$description: Restricted answer: sealed, read only through Reveal. Guarded, not an error. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

sensitivity-restricted-ink.$description: Sensitivity restricted: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

consent-granted.$description: Consent given. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

consent-granted-ink.$description: Consent granted: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

consent-withdrawn.$description: Consent withdrawn: honoured, not an error. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

consent-withdrawn-ink.$description: Consent withdrawn: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

consent-unknown.$description: Consent not known. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

consent-unknown-ink.$description: Consent unknown: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

consent-erased.$description: The person was erased; the record of it remains. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

consent-erased-ink.$description: Consent erased: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

priority-low.$description: Priority low. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

priority-low-ink.$description: Priority low: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

priority-normal.$description: Priority normal. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

priority-normal-ink.$description: Priority normal: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

priority-high.$description: Priority high. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

priority-high-ink.$description: Priority high: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

priority-urgent.$description: Priority urgent: still not the SLA’s breached red. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

priority-urgent-ink.$description: Priority urgent: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

consent-suppressed.$description: Consent suppressed: held back on purpose, guarded rather than an error. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

consent-suppressed-ink.$description: Consent suppressed: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

delivery-queued.$description: Delivery queued: waiting its turn. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

delivery-queued-ink.$description: Delivery queued: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

delivery-accepted.$description: Delivery accepted: the provider took the request, nothing more. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

delivery-accepted-ink.$description: Delivery accepted: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

delivery-matched.$description: Delivery matched: the provider tied it to a person. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

delivery-matched-ink.$description: Delivery matched: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

delivery-suppressed.$description: Delivery suppressed: held back because consent was missing. Guarded, not failed. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

delivery-suppressed-ink.$description: Delivery suppressed: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

delivery-failed.$description: Delivery dead-lettered: it will not be retried and needs a person. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

delivery-failed-ink.$description: Delivery failed: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

freshness-fresh.$description: Fresh: reviewed within its schedule. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

freshness-fresh-ink.$description: Freshness fresh: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

freshness-due.$description: Due soon: its review falls due shortly. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

freshness-due-ink.$description: Freshness due: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

freshness-stale.$description: Stale: past its review. A stale page is not an error, so never red. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

freshness-stale-ink.$description: Freshness stale: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

effect-read.$description: Reads data only. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

effect-read-ink.$description: Effect read: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

effect-write.$description: Changes data: calm but unmistakable, never danger red. (demand list colour role). Mark: glyphs and dots.

effect-write-ink.$description: Effect write: text on its fill or on white (4.5:1).

attention.$description: Attention (CLR-14): "Needs you" on every dashboard. The signature orange as a mark, never a control.

attention-tint.$description: Attention: fill of a "Needs you" chip.

attention-ink.$description: Attention: text and glyph on its fill (4.5:1, checked as orange-ink on orange-surface).

family.$description: Product typeface. Applications load Inter; the stack falls back to system fonts.

sm.$description: Helper text, small buttons and table metadata.

md.$description: Default control, body and table text.

lg.$description: Container titles, large buttons and body copy.

line-height.$description: Line height for body and control text.

stroke.$description: Icon stroke width in a 24-unit viewBox.

mark.$description: Checkboxes, small marks, and rows or buttons nested 4 px inside an 8 px corner.

inner.$description: Blocks, days and small buttons inside a control or floating panel.

control.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects and other single controls. Composite rails (tab tracks, segmented controls) use card.

float.$description: Menus, popovers, pickers, select lists and tooltips: the same corner as the control they open from, so the corners line up when one opens over a button.

card.$description: Cards, panels, sections, list cards and composite fields such as the composer.

overlay.$description: Dialogs, drawers, bottom sheets and chat bubbles.

2.$description: Gaps inside controls and button groups.

enter.$description: Content arriving: a page, a section, a list.

stagger.$description: The gap between items that arrive one after another.

press.$description: A control sinking under a press: quick, so it answers the finger at once.

release.$description: A control springing back on release, a toggle crossing, a selection settling (with ease-spring).

arrive.$description: A menu, popover, dialog or drawer arriving (with ease-spring-soft).

exit.$description: Anything leaving: faster than it arrived, so it never holds up the next step (with ease-in).

ease-spring.$description: A spring, damping 0.72: about 4% overshoot, then rest. Releases, toggles and selections.

ease-spring-soft.$description: A spring, damping 0.85: under 1% overshoot. Things arriving: menus, dialogs, the sliding selection.

operation-delay.$description: No artificial delays; operations take their real time.

card.$description: Cards are separated from the page by fill, not shadow.

overlay.$description: Floating layers use a contrasting panel fill (white, grey or ink), not shadow.

ring.$description: Halo focus: one solid 2px edge plus a soft glow, never an offset double ring.

field.$description: Field focus: the outline turns primary-fill and this soft halo surrounds it (one ring, no outline).

inset.$description: Focus inside a clipped row or shell (menu rows, list items, accordion headers): one solid inset edge.

field-error.$description: Field focus while the field is in error: the outline turns danger and this soft red halo surrounds it.

on-fill.$description: Focus on a filled item (current sidebar link, selected day, checked control): a surface gap, then the primary edge, so the ring never merges into the fill.

offset.$description: Raised by nested overlay layers at runtime.

breakpoint.$description: Screen size classes (min-width of each class): compact < medium, medium 600-1023, expanded 1024-1439, large 1440-1919, wide 1920 and up. Screen media queries only; components follow their container.

medium.$description: Medium and wider: tablets, split views, small laptops. Below it is compact (phones).
